reason: In a normal week without filing deadline panic, I will not pay for software when I worry an assistant might accidentally delete or move our client folders directly in Google Drive. For my two-person practice, I would at most test the free sandbox rather than committing to a paid annual plan.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Guaranteed move and delete protection for Google Drive folders so assistants cannot tamper with them, plus deadline pressure during the October ROC rush requiring maker-checker audit trails.
